name: KPI
summary: Single headline metric with optional delta.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no keyboard: it is a Card with a label, a number and an optional trend, all as text. Nothing is focusable — a KPI that opens a detail view wraps the action around it, it does not become one.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being measured. Sits above the number, in muted text.

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself, already formatted — the component does not format.

props.name: trend
props.description: The change, as a node and not a number: the sign, the unit and the wording belong to the domain, not to a card.
